(2) 'It allowed over two weeks for delivery' is true on order date Sept. 8 to required-by Sept. 25 (17 days), but a solver who measures to the scheduled delivery on Sept. 22 gets exactly 14 days and could pick B as the false one. Fix both before shipping.

overall: Three well-made triples that follow the official shape (table plus e-mails or order form; purpose, word-meaning, NOT or inference, two or three cross-document questions in order). Checked: weekdays (April 16, Sept. 14 and 22, Nov. 23 and 30 all agree with a 2026 calendar), arithmetic (order total $4,968 qualifies for free delivery; refund (226 - 189) x 6 = $222; 6 x 189 = 1,134; 17 days from Sept. 8 to Sept. 25), times (opening address 8:30 + 15 = 8:45; Room 112 slot 10:45-12:00; he leaves at 1:00), colors against the price list, crew size 18 against about 25 staff, and week-of-Nov. 23 against Nov. 21-25 travel. No internal inconsistencies found. No option is defensible as a second answer in any of the 15 questions; the one soft spot is r-p7-02:0 (wording of two options, see shouldFix). Bands: 9 hard, 5 medium, 1 easy (60 / 33 / 7 percent), which meets the round target. Several hard items are at the lower end of hard (r-p7-01:1, r-p7-03:1) because the cross-document step is short. Option lengths and shapes are balanced in all three sets (no key is the longest or the only two-part option).
